title: Bounds for multi-horizon stochastic optimization with application to power generation and transmission expansion planning
summary: This paper investigates computationally efficient methods for deriving bounds on the optimal value of multi-horizon stochastic optimization problems, with a particular focus on applications in power generation and transmission expansion planning. Multi-horizon stochastic programs capture sequential decision-making under uncertainty across multiple time scales---e.g., strategic (long-term) and operational (short-term)---jointly.
